triplets.condition: Multi-phase formalization task starts without verified Lean specs.
triplets.guidance: Route theorem design through @lean-specification and @counterexample-first-proving before invoking @lean-proof.
triplets.pitfalls: Skipping specification risks proving vacuous or Nat-truncated statements.

triplets.condition: Conjecture involves Nat subtraction, division, or boundary quantifiers.
triplets.guidance: Run Plausible / boundary witness checks and lean_analyzer SOUND-04 before spending tactic budget.
triplets.pitfalls: Attempting to prove a falsifiable Nat-truncation statement wastes hundreds of tactic turns.

triplets.condition: Goal is a fixed-width BitVec or closed constant identity.
triplets.guidance: Attempt rfl first; escalate to bv_decide on symbolic BitVec w goals.
triplets.pitfalls: Note that bv_decide introduces Lean.ofReduceBool; use sair_decide on strict 3-axiom contest lanes.

triplets.condition: Strict 3-axiom contest lane forbids Lean.ofReduceBool and Lean.trustCompiler.
triplets.guidance: Use sair_decide (rfl | decide +kernel | omega) to stay strictly inside [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound].
triplets.pitfalls: Never substitute native_decide (banned across the entire corpus by GT-30/31).

triplets.condition: Uninterpreted function symbols f, g mix with commutative/associative equalities where simp loops.
triplets.guidance: Invoke eqsat_rw [hcomm, ...] (or egg_rw) for pure-Lean congruence saturation, or grind_close for SMT E-matching.
triplets.pitfalls: Directional simp [hcomm] diverges on symmetric equations f x y = f y x.

triplets.condition: Double Finset.sum requires Finset.sum_comm swap plus scalar distribution.
triplets.guidance: Use calc_ring_sum to commute summation indices and normalize linear ring factors in one step.
triplets.pitfalls: Manual Finset.sum_comm inside nested lambdas requires explicit Finset.sum_congr rfl wrappers.

triplets.condition: Pointwise inequality under summation contains products with non-negative weights.
triplets.guidance: Let finset_mono introduce the summation index and instantiate hypotheses, then discharge products via gcongr_pos.
triplets.pitfalls: Plain linarith cannot discharge nonlinear products c i * f i <= c i * g i without positivity/gcongr.

triplets.condition: Closed shift-add or SWAR lane masks appear inside kernel-reduced definitions.
triplets.guidance: Fold closed constants at elaboration time via eval_nat% and unroll static loops via swar_unroll%.
triplets.pitfalls: Leaving OfNat.ofNat or open shift-add expressions inside Nat.rec step lambdas incurs ~160K WHNF instructions per call.

triplets.condition: Theorem statement mixes abstract algebraic properties with bit-packed compute loops.
triplets.guidance: Establish clean f_spec + concrete f_fast connected by theorem f_eq : f_fast = f_spec := rfl (WAVE-13 G1 duality).
triplets.pitfalls: Threading typeclass dictionaries inside hot kernel loops causes a 1,600x-3,345x WHNF slowdown.

triplets.condition: Module compiles cleanly and enters final release / PR verification.
triplets.guidance: Run Tier-1 lean-rules (WASM + YAML) and axiom_audit.py alongside 4-layer semantic proof review.
triplets.pitfalls: Zero compiler errors alone does not catch tautologies, hypothesis weakening, or Classical.choice drift.

rejection_memory.error_reason: Banned by GT-30/31: injects Lean.trustCompiler into axiom closure; replace with decide +kernel, bv_decide, or omega.

rejection_memory.goal_signature: n m : Nat |- n - m + m = n
rejection_memory.error_reason: Falsified by SOUND-04 Nat subtraction truncation when n < m (witness n=0, m=1); require h : m <= n.

rejection_memory.goal_signature: f : a -> a -> a, hcomm : forall x y, f x y = f y x |- f (g a) c = f c (g c)
rejection_memory.error_reason: Non-terminating directional rewrite loop on symmetric commutativity; use eqsat_rw [hcomm] instead.
Classical split on && / if-then-else leaks Classical.choice into constructive Bool theorems; use contra_direct.
